newsitem.title: USA: Zytec sees Q2 revs up 20 pct from Q1.
newsitem.headline: Zytec sees Q2 revs up 20 pct from Q1.

text.p: Zytec Corp chief executive office Ronald Schmidt said Monday he expected revenue for the second quarter of 1997 to be up 20 percent from the first quarter.

"We expect revenue in the second quarter to grow by 20 percent, compared to the first quarter," Schmidt told Reuters following the company's annual meeting. The company reported sales of $56.7 million in the first quarter and $60.7 million in the year ago second quarter.
The growth in the market for electronic power equipment is 10-12 percent and the company's Zytec targets are growing more, Schmidt said.
He said he expected revenues to grow 33 percent over the entire year from last year's $228.2 million.
Zytec shares closed down 1/4 at 12-1/2 Monday.
